_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
_note: Operator directive of 2026-09-08 (session legend-development-2e): distribute the 54 Aqeilan PubMed-free-full-text PMIDs across scientist-a/b/c, skipping what is already read, and proceed autonomously for ~10 hours. The orchestrator ran the duplicate-work gate over the receipt ledger before assigning: 31 of the 54 already carry a complete_fulltext_read receipt and are NOT assigned. 23 remain — 14 with no receipt at all, 9 with a partial or legacy-only receipt.
OBJECTIVE: Take each assigned PMID from acquisition to a durable, verifiable full-text reading: complete_fulltext_read where the available surface permits it, honestly partial where it does not, with verbatim locators captured while the document is open, a schema-v2 work manifest that passes the strict validator, a dossier, and a receipt appended through the validated writer.

SCOPE.theme: metabolic / hepatic / lipid axis, BRCA1 mammary line, and the fragile-site review layer
SCOPE.single_owner: Every PMID in this lot has exactly one owner. No PMID appears in two lots, so no PARALLEL_READ_GROUP is needed and none is declared.
SCOPE.excluded: The four scientific current files (working_model, claim_registry, paper_registry, literature_tracking_log) and disease_model.md are NOT touched: they move only through BATCH_COMMIT, which the orchestrator runs at the end. Produce commit candidates instead.

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: For each PMID: deepdive_manifest.py --pmid <PMID> --verify-artifacts --require-current-schema exits PASS with 0 gaps, run from the shared root checkout.
For each PMID: fulltext_receipts.py record --receipt <event.json> succeeded, and fulltext_receipts.py verify is OK afterwards.

For each PMID: a dossier in disease-models/wwox/research/fulltext_dossiers/PMID<PMID>.md that states what the reading found, what it does NOT support, and the transfer verdict toward the reference genotype.
Every evidentiary locator carries surface + fingerprinted artifact; abstract is never the evidentiary surface.
Figures inspected at native resolution wherever the images are lawfully retrievable; captions_only is declared as such and downgrades the receipt.
legend_lint.py . stays PASS after every commit.
A commit candidate exists for any reading that would change or qualify a registry record or a claim.
DEPENDENCIES: duplicate-work gate already run by the orchestrator over fulltext_read_receipts.jsonl on 2026-09-08
REVIEW_REQUIREMENT: Ladder floor R2. R4 / legend-locator-audit is REQUIRED before any reading is allowed to narrow, reverse, corroborate or remove a consolidated baseline claim, or to justify a MAJOR working-model bump.

RETRY_POLICY.on_exhaust: PARK the single PMID with a written acquisition-cascade record, and continue with the next PMID in the lot

MILESTONE_PLAN: M1 acquisition — lawful structured full text (XML/HTML preferred over PDF) in files/fulltext/, figures in files/figures/PMID<PMID>/, SHA-256 recorded
M2 reading — section-by-section coverage map, verbatim locators captured while the document is open
M3 manifest — schema-v2 deepdive manifest, strict validator PASS
M4 receipt — appended through fulltext_receipts.py record
M5 dossier + commit candidate — persisted and committed on main
